question: The 38th edition of the 2025 National Games of India was hosted by which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__.

**__Key Points__**

__

• The **38th edition** of the **National Games of India** is scheduled to be held in **Uttarakhand** in **2025**, specifically spanning from **January 28 to February 14**.

• The **Indian Olympic Association (IOA)** officially announced that the state would host approximately **38 sports disciplines**, featuring participation from over **10,000 athletes** and officials.

• The events are planned to take place across several districts, including **Dehradun**, **Haldwani**, **Haridwar**, and **Rudrapur**, utilizing specialized venues like the **Maharana Pratap Sports College**.

• The **Himalayan Monal**, which is the **state bird** of Uttarakhand, has been chosen as the **official mascot** for this multi-sport event to promote regional identity and biodiversity.

• This edition is part of a larger initiative to enhance **winter sports** infrastructure and high-altitude training facilities in the Himalayan region, positioning the state as a future hub for national and international competitions.

 **Additional Information__**

• **Context of Previous Editions:**

• **37th National Games (2023):** These were hosted by **Goa**, where **Maharashtra** finished at the top of the medal table, securing the **Raja Bhalindra Singh Trophy**.

• **36th National Games (2022):** Held in **Gujarat** across six cities, this edition marked the revival of the games after a gap of seven years since the 2015 edition in Kerala.

• **Haryana:** Known for its dominant performance in **Wrestling** and **Boxing**, this state consistently finishes in the top tier of the overall championship rankings.

• **Indian Olympic Association (IOA):** Established in **1927**, it is the premier body responsible for overseeing the **National Games** and India's participation in the **Olympics** and **Asian Games**.

• **Origins:** The first-ever Indian Olympic Games (now National Games) took place in **Lahore** in **1924**, aimed at selecting athletes for the Olympic Games.
